title: Hadith Hub
description: The hadith section of Islamic Internet Archives: the full text of Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī and Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, an atlas of narrators across 953 books, trees of their narrators and the library's writings on hadith.
intro: Tools and references for studying the Prophet's sayings and the chains that carried them. Everything here is searchable from the search box at the top of any page, and each chart carries an archived date and a note on how to cite it.

tiles.heading: Narrators of the Ḥadīth
tiles.text: An atlas of the chains in 953 books of ḥadīth: every narrator's teachers and students, the books they appear in, and the busiest route back to the Prophet ﷺ.

tiles.heading: Narrators of Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī
tiles.text: Every narrator in al-Bukhārī's chains as a tree you can open branch by branch, from the Prophet ﷺ to al-Bukhārī, with dates, generations and Ibn Ḥajar's grades.

tiles.heading: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī
tiles.text: The whole collection in Arabic and English, book by book, searchable in either language. Every chain of narrators links to the narrator tree.

tiles.heading: Narrators of Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim
tiles.text: Every narrator in Muslim's chains as a tree you can open branch by branch, from the Prophet ﷺ to Muslim, with dates, generations and Ibn Ḥajar's grades.

tiles.heading: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim
tiles.text: The whole collection in Arabic and English, book by book, searchable in either language and numbered as on sunnah.com.

tiles.heading: Hadith studies in the library
tiles.text: Books, papers and essays on the transmission, criticism and authority of hadith, from the library.
